name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT DARKLOPS ZERO -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT DARKLOPS ZERO -ACTION-

ja: 月刊ホビージャパン連載の『ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE』より、ウルトラマンゼロのライバル「ダークロプスゼロ」がULTRAMAN SUITで登場！
■特徴的なモノアイを新規パーツで再現。
■腹部関節は「可動優先時」と「LEDユニット（別売り）内蔵時」の２パターンの選択式。
■LEDユニット（別売り）を胸部に収め、胸と目を光らせることができる。
en: From "ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE " serialized in Hobby Japan, Ultraman Zero's rival " Darklops Zero" appears in ULTRAMAN SUIT!
• Reproduce the characteristic mono-eye with new parts.
• The abdominal joint can be selected from two patterns: "when movable is prioritized " and " when the LED unit (sold separately) is built in".
• An LED unit (sold separately) can be placed in the chest to make the chest and eyes shine.

ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×各2種
en: Hand parts (left and right) x 2 types each
